title: Permission requests and denials, compactions and API-error turn ends leave closed ops rows
goal: ql_capture writes closed ops rows for the PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, PreCompact, PostCompact and StopFailure hook events: tool group, trigger or error class, agent group and counts, never a reason text, command, summary or path; a test per event shows the row, and a planted payload with free text in each field shows none of it stored.

gates.question: Approve recording closed rows for permission requests and denials, compactions and API-error turn ends (classes and counts only)?
